id./param/scenario/cs/c_010_cs_005.pack|cs_:
"Lady Serenica... The time has come
  for us to fulfill our duty.

"With the Orbs we've gathered, I'll guide
  the Luminary {var:1} to the World Tree,
  where the power to dispel evil sleeps.

"The Tree is unexplored, open only to the
  chosen. I don't know what awaits there
  until we go. But...

"{var:1} is our light of hope.
  As long as it shines, the world won't be
  swallowed by darkness. I believe that!

"So please watch over us, Lady Serenica,
  that we may fulfill our mission safely!

"Aaah! {var:1}!
  Y-you didn't hear that, did you...

"...And what's with that huge sword!
  Where have you been all this time!?

"You vanished all of a sudden while we
  were listening to the Elder!
  You scared me half to death!

"...What's wrong with you?
  Looking at me with that near-tears face
  is throwing me off.

"We have a big job ahead, and the most
  important person looks like that?
  Pull yourself together, Luminary!

"Eek, {var:1}, darling! Thank goodness,
  you're back!? I was worried sick
  when you were nowhere to be found!

"...What is it, {var:1}, darling?
  You've been staring at
  everyone's faces...

"Hey, {var:1}. That's a wild sword.
  Carrying that, no wonder they call
  you the Devil's Child.

"Ha ha... well, whatever.
  Let's get to the World Tree already.
  I'm tired of waiting!

"If we offer our six Orbs at the altar atop
  the Forest of Origins, we can reach
  the World Tree, right?

"The Elder said we can reach the forest
  through that door. Let's head for
  the altar on the summit first.

"Now, our long journey nears its end.
  Let's go to the World Tree to defeat
  the evil Mordegon!
